Sound familiar?

You know how to make things happen. So why does it feel this hard?

  • The goals keep getting ticked off, and the feeling you wanted never quite arrives.
  • Manifesting turned into another thing to get right: more journaling, more vision boards, more pressure.
  • Rest feels like falling behind, so you keep pushing.
  • Part of you knows there is a softer way to create. You just haven’t been shown it.

Here’s what you’ll learn

Five shifts we’ll cover in 60 minutes

Why high achievers manifest differently

Why pushing harder and adding more techniques can keep driven women stuck in the same loop.

Survival Self vs Soul Self

Listening for the whispers

Feelings as information

Ad creatives · Video scripts · Meta

Video ad scripts for the Soul Self Masterclass

Script 1 · “The vision board”

Hook (0 to 3s)

“Most of the high achievers I work with have made every vision board there is.”

Body

“And they still feel like they’re pushing a boulder uphill. That’s not because manifesting doesn’t work for them. It’s because their Survival Self is the one doing it. Pressure in, pressure out.”

CTA

“I’m teaching a different way in a free 60-minute masterclass. Replay included. Tap Sign up to save your seat.”

Shot: talking to camera, light blazer, natural light, on-screen text “Survival Self” in orange.

Script 2 · “Two selves”

Hook (0 to 3s)

“There are two versions of you that can make a decision.”

Body

“One creates from survival: proving, controlling, never resting. The other creates from your soul: calm, trust, truth. Same goals, very different experience of getting there. The work is learning to tell them apart.”

CTA

“I’ll show you how in the Soul Self Masterclass. It’s live, it’s free, and it’s 60 minutes. Tap Sign up.”

Shot: split screen, “Survival Self” on the left in sand, “Soul Self” on the right in orange.

Script 3 · “The whispers”

Hook (0 to 3s)

“The first thing I teach every woman I work with: listen for the whispers.”

Body

“The whispers are the small nudges you keep talking yourself out of. Ignore them long enough and they get louder. Learn to hear them early, and creating starts to feel a lot less like effort.”

CTA

“It’s lesson one in my free live masterclass. Tap Sign up below to join me.”

Shot: talking to camera, slow push in, soft music, caption “lesson one”.
